# Kevin Bishop: full profile

Source: https://www.kevin-bish.com/ · Last updated: 2026-11-01

Digitization and trade-data standards specialist at UNECE / UN/CEFACT in Geneva. Secretary of the UN/LOCODE Advisory Group and of UN/EDIFACT, focal point for methodology and technology, and Secretary of ISO/TC 154/JWG 9.

## Experience

### Secretary, UN/LOCODE Advisory Group, United Nations Economic Commission for Europe (UNECE) (2024-04 to Present)

Location: Geneva, Switzerland

Coordinates intergovernmental maintenance and strategic development of UN/LOCODE, the UN Code for Trade and Transport Locations (116,000+ codes).

- Runs the directory release cycle: cut-off schedules, expert review, Data Maintenance Requests under Recommendation No. 16, publication after each UN/CEFACT Forum
- Leads modernization with UN OICT and UNICC toward an open-source, version-controlled maintenance environment
- Migration of UN/LOCODE, UNTP and the eTIR National Application to the UN open-source platform; due diligence (SBOM, SCA, security, licensing) toward Digital Public Good status
- Geolocation tagging, geofencing and AI-assisted validation of requests
- Resource mobilization including the contribution-based funding mechanism endorsed at UN/CEFACT Plenary
- Capacity building for National Focal Points

### Associate Information Management Officer, UNECE · UN/CEFACT secretariat, Digital Connectivity Unit (2021-11 to Present)

Location: Geneva, Switzerland

Focal point for UN/CEFACT Methodology and Technology; Secretary of UN/EDIFACT.

- Maintenance of UN/EDIFACT, UN/CCL, Reference Data Models, UN/LOCODE and Recommendation code lists
- Management of UN/FLUX with FAO, ICCAT and regional fisheries bodies
- Support to JSON Schema, JSON-LD web vocabulary, Verifiable Credentials and API specifications
- Servicing of UN/CEFACT Plenary, Forum, Bureau and expert meetings
- Communications and outreach for the Digital Connectivity Unit and UN/CEFACT; management of the CUE (Confluence) environment
- Co-Chair, UN Digital Transformation Group for Europe and Central Asia

### Secretary, ISO/TC 154/JWG 9, International Organization for Standardization (ISO) (2023-11 to Present)

Joint ISO/UNECE working group on information exchange in the supply chain aligned to UN/CEFACT semantics.

- ISO/AWI 7372 Trade Data Elements Directory
- ISO/DIS 20197-1 Buy-Ship-Pay Reference Data Model
- ISO/WD 5909 DLT-based electronic bill of lading
- ISO/PWI 16356 edible agricultural products on blockchain/DLT
- ISO/PWI 25534-1 Digital Product Passport

### ICT Management Specialist, Haigh Communications Inc. (2019-02 to 2021-10)

Location: Barbados

Single point of contact for ICT at a Barbados PR consultancy serving the Government of Barbados and UNICEF, from network infrastructure to first-line support.

### Teaching Assistant, The University of the West Indies (2019-08 to 2021-02)

Location: Barbados

Taught Computing I and Entrepreneurship for Computer Sciences to classes of 15 to 40 students, covering Java, C++, JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS.

### Quantitative Research Analyst, UNDP (2013-02 to 2015-12)

Location: Barbados

Consultant analyst producing statistical research for UNDP and UN-Women, including a Caribbean multi-dimensional poverty paper and a gender analysis of OECS poverty.

### Research Consultant, Caribbean Policy Development Centre (2012-02 to 2013-08)

Location: Barbados

### Research Assistant, University of the West Indies (2010-06 to 2012-09)

Location: Barbados

### Intern, Test & Dispatch Technician, LIME (2010-07 to 2010-08)

Location: Barbados

### Intern, IT Technical Analyst, CIBC FirstCaribbean International Bank (2008-01 to 2008-05)

Location: Barbados

## Volunteer and community

Supported UNODC's rapid Urban Safety Governance Assessment in Barbados (December 2020) by mobilizing residents to provide qualitative data.
- Committee Chairperson and grant proposal writer, Deacons Development Project (community centre)
